phases.script:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE"
split_phase_start=$SECONDS
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$(( SECONDS - split_phase_start ))" > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/preflight-duration-seconds.txt"' EXIT
selected_xcode="/Applications/Xcode.app"
test -d "$selected_xcode/Contents/Developer"
export DEVELOPER_DIR="$selected_xcode/Contents/Developer"
echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=$DEVELOPER_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
{
  sw_vers
  uname -m
  xcodebuild -version
  xcodebuild -showsdks
  xcrun simctl list runtimes -j
  xcrun simctl list devicetypes -j
  command -v python3
  python3 --version
  command -v xcodebuild
  command -v xcrun
  df -Pk . "$RUNNER_TEMP"
  command -v idb && idb --version || true
  command -v maestro && maestro --version || true
} > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/preflight.log" 2>&1
cat "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/preflight.log"
test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -gt 15000000
test "$(xcrun --sdk iphonesimulator --show-sdk-version | cut -d. -f1)" -ge 27
echo "arch=$(uname -m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "xcode_build=$(xcodebuild -version | sed -n '2s/^Build version //p')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "sdk=$(xcrun --sdk iphonesimulator --show-sdk-version)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
skill_script="$HOME/.codex/skills/ios-simulator-skill/scripts/sim_health_check.sh"
if [ -f "$skill_script" ]; then
  bash "$skill_script" --json > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/skill-health.json" 2>&1 || true
else
  echo 'NOT_AVAILABLE: ios-simulator-skill scripts on this Mac; XCUITest remains available.' > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/skill-health.txt"
fi
plutil -lint AI_HLY.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj HanlinMiniAppsApp/HanlinMiniApps.entitlements
python3 Scripts/ProductSplit/verify_targets.py
phases.source: .github/workflows/validate-app-split.yml#split-platform; only installed primary Xcode app path selection adapted

phases.script:
set -euo pipefail
trap 'cp build/acceptance/miniapp-upstreams/resolution.json "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-resolution.json" 2>/dev/null || true; git diff --binary > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-inputs.patch"' EXIT
node Scripts/MiniApps/resolve-upstreams.mjs --apply --cache="$RUNNER_TEMP/hanlin-miniapp-upstreams" 2>&1 | tee "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-resolution.log"
cp build/acceptance/miniapp-upstreams/resolution.json "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-resolution.json"
git diff --binary > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-inputs.patch"

set -euo pipefail
python3 Scripts/ProductSplit/run_portable.py --suite foreground | tee "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/foreground.log"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib, shutil
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
report = root / 'docs/product-split/foreground-results.json'
data = json.loads(report.read_text())
assert data['status'] == 'EXECUTED_PASS' and data['count'] == 53
origin = pathlib.Path(data['raw_evidence_manifest']['path']).parent.resolve()
assert origin.is_relative_to((root / 'docs/product-split/evidence').resolve())
destination = pathlib.Path(os.environ['SPLIT_EVIDENCE']) / 'foreground'
destination.mkdir()
shutil.copy2(report, destination / report.name)
shutil.copytree(origin, destination / 'raw-origin')
PY

set -euo pipefail
split_phase_start=$SECONDS
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$(( SECONDS - split_phase_start ))" > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/package-lifecycle-duration-seconds.txt"' EXIT
test "$(node --version)" = 'v24.5.0'
host_root="$PWD/AI_HLY/Downstream/RuntimeCore/Node/Host"
grammar_root="$PWD/Scripts/Runtime/HostGrammarTools"
export HANLIN_HOST_GRAMMAR_COMPILER_ROOT="$grammar_root"
npm ci --prefix "$grammar_root" --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false --no-audit --no-fund
npm ci --prefix "$host_root" --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false --no-audit --no-fund
(cd "$host_root" && node apply-host-dependency-patches.mjs)
node Scripts/Runtime/generate-yarn-unicode-patch.mjs --root "$host_root"
node Scripts/Runtime/generate-yarn-multiline-patch.mjs --root "$host_root" --compiler-root "$grammar_root"
{
  node --version
  shasum -a 256 "$host_root/global-package-state.mjs" "$host_root/Tests/package-lifecycle.test.mjs" "$host_root/package-lock.json"
  node --test "$host_root/Tests/package-lifecycle.test.mjs"
} 2>&1 | tee "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/package-lifecycle.log"
if [[ 'miniapp_complete' == 'miniapp_authoring' || 'miniapp_complete' == 'miniapp_complete' ]]; then
  miniapp_cli_root="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/hanlin-cli-preflight.XXXXXX")"
  mkdir -p "$miniapp_cli_root/Tests"
  cp "$host_root/miniapp-authoring.mjs" "$miniapp_cli_root/"
  cp "$host_root/Tests/miniapp-authoring.test.mjs" "$miniapp_cli_root/Tests/"
  ln -s "$host_root/node_modules" "$miniapp_cli_root/node_modules"
  (cd "$miniapp_cli_root"
    unset HANLIN_AUTHORING_TYPESCRIPT
    export HANLIN_MINIAPP_REPOSITORY_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
    node --test --test-name-pattern='the real CLI archives and revalidates retained source, diagnostics and output identity' Tests/miniapp-authoring.test.mjs
  ) 2>&1 | tee "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/miniapp-cli-relocation.log"
fi

echo "digest=$(xcodebuild -version | shasum -a 256 | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -f Scripts/NativeScript/node_modules/@nativescript/ios/package.json ]; then
  npm ci --prefix Scripts/NativeScript --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
fi
python3 Scripts/NativeScript/build-metadata-tool.py
phases.source: .github/actions/prepare-nativescript-metadata-tool/action.yml; no compatible primary tool cache established

phases.script:
set -euo pipefail
split_phase_start=$SECONDS
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$(( SECONDS - split_phase_start ))" > "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/native-dependencies-duration-seconds.txt"' EXIT
{
node Scripts/MiniApps/install-tooling.mjs --engine=nativescript --ignore-scripts
npm run prepare:ios-dependencies --prefix Scripts/NativeScript
node Scripts/MiniApps/install-tooling.mjs --engine=expo --ignore-scripts
node Scripts/Expo/prepare-ios-dependencies.mjs
node Scripts/Expo/prepare-types.mjs
node Scripts/Expo/build-probe.mjs
node Scripts/ExpoNativeAPI/build-probes.mjs
bash Scripts/Runtime/prepare-runtime-core.sh
bash Scripts/Runtime/prepare-runtime-host.sh
cp build/runtime-host/RuntimeHostResources.zip AI_HLY/RuntimeHostResources.zip
# Check the actual public guide blocks against the exact SDK in the verified shipping ZIP.
# Static authoring checks do not imply a MiniApp launched or a native service executed.
node Scripts/MiniApps/check-authoring-examples.mjs --sdk-archive build/runtime-host/RuntimeHostResources.zip --require-sdk-docs --report "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/miniapp-documentation-snippets.json"
# The verified ZIP above is the shipping payload. The lifecycle check's
# temporary npm tree must not enter Xcode's synchronized app resources.
rm -rf AI_HLY/Downstream/RuntimeCore/Node/Host/node_modules
test ! -e AI_HLY/Downstream/RuntimeCore/Node/Host/node_modules
cat > Config.xcconfig <<'EOF'
SWIFT_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_MODULES = NO
SWIFT_OBJC_INTEROP_MODE = objcxx
CLANG_CXX_LANGUAGE_STANDARD = gnu++20
CLANG_ALLOW_NON_MODULAR_INCLUDES_IN_FRAMEWORK_MODULES = YES
CLANG_WARN_QUOTED_INCLUDE_IN_FRAMEWORK_HEADER = NO
EOF
} 2>&1 | tee "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/native-dependencies.log"

set -euo pipefail
python3 Scripts/SDK/native_artifacts.py export --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --output "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/prepared-native"
python3 Scripts/SDK/native_artifacts.py verify --catalog "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/prepared-native/native-artifacts.json" --assets "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/prepared-native"
cp Scripts/MiniApps/upstream-resolution.json "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/prepared-native/upstream-resolution.json"
cp "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/upstream-inputs.patch" "$SPLIT_EVIDENCE/prepared-native/upstream-inputs.patch"

phases.source: .github/workflows/validate-app-split.yml#Restore verified input timestamps for incremental compilation

phases.script:
python3 Scripts/CI/xcode_cache_inputs.py --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" capture \
  --manifest "$SPLIT_DERIVED_DATA/CacheMetadata/xcode-build-inputs.json" --head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --directory-root . AI_HLY AI_HLYTests AI_HLYUITests HanlinMiniAppsApp HanlinMiniAppsUITests HanlinMiniAppsTests Packages AI_HLY.xcodeproj Vendor Config.xcconfig RuntimeDependencies.lock.json
